subject: Emotions
title: Panic and Frozen Response
description: A fast breakdown of Panic and Frozen Response for builders.

hook.text: In emergencies, 75% of people freeze. They don't panic, don't run, don't help. They just stop.

buildup.text: Freezing is a third stress response alongside fight and flight. Extreme surprise can trigger total shutdown.

discovery.text: The brain freezes when no prediction matches the situation. Without a model, there's no action plan.

twist.text: Training works by pre-loading scenarios. Firefighters and pilots rehearse disasters so surprise doesn't freeze them.

climax.text: The key to surviving surprise isn't bravery. It's preparation—having a mental model before you need one.

punchline.text: Courage isn't the antidote to panic. Rehearsal is.

quiz.question: Why do people freeze in emergencies?
options: No prediction model matches the situation
